use default

render(s: SET[int]) -> string is
    let items = s |> collect_list()
    items.sort()

    "{{{items |> join(", ")}}}"
si

let a = SET([1, 2, 3, 4])
let b = SET([3, 4, 5, 6])

write_line("A = {render(a)}")
write_line("B = {render(b)}")
write_line("3 is in A: {a.contains(3)}")
write_line("10 is in A: {a.contains(10)}")

let combined = SET(a)
combined.union_with(b)
write_line("A union B = {render(combined)}")

let intersection = SET(a)
intersection.intersect_with(b)
write_line("A intersect B = {render(intersection)}")

let difference = SET(a)
difference.except_with(b)
write_line("A - B = {render(difference)}")

write_line("{{1, 2}} subset of A: {SET([1, 2]).is_subset_of(a)}")
write_line("A subset of B: {a.is_subset_of(b)}")

write_line("A = {{4, 3, 2, 1}}: {a.set_equals(SET([4, 3, 2, 1]))}")
write_line("A = B: {a.set_equals(b)}")

let mutable = SET(a)
mutable.add(99)
write_line("after adding 99: {render(mutable)}")
mutable.remove(99)
write_line("after removing 99: {render(mutable)}")

use default

render(s: SET[int]) -> string is
    let items = s |> collect_list()
    items.sort()

    "{{{items |> join(", ")}}}"
si

let a = SET([1, 2, 3, 4])
let b = SET([3, 4, 5, 6])

write_line("A = {render(a)}")
write_line("B = {render(b)}")
write_line("3 is in A: {a.contains(3)}")
write_line("10 is in A: {a.contains(10)}")

let combined = SET(a)
combined.union_with(b)
write_line("A union B = {render(combined)}")

let intersection = SET(a)
intersection.intersect_with(b)
write_line("A intersect B = {render(intersection)}")

let difference = SET(a)
difference.except_with(b)
write_line("A - B = {render(difference)}")

write_line("{{1, 2}} subset of A: {SET([1, 2]).is_subset_of(a)}")
write_line("A subset of B: {a.is_subset_of(b)}")
